firstPartyCooldown.prompt: Using base-ten diagrams, explain how to share 156 equally among four groups, showing every trade.
firstPartyCooldown.teacherAnswer: 39 each. Exchange the hundred into ten tens, combine five tens to get fifteen tens. Share twelve tens among four groups, leaving three tens. Exchange to thirty ones, add six ones, then share thirty-six ones, nine each. Each group 3 tens + 9 ones =39.
